title: Enhancing Legal Reasoning in Pre-trained Language Models via Knowledge Graph-Guided Multi-Task Pre-training
abstract: arXiv:2610.13722v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Legal language understanding requires reasoning over semi-structured regulatory documents, yet standard pre-training objectives do not explicitly target this structural capability. Because current legal language models rely solely on masked language modeling, they treat statutory text as flat token sequences and ignore the underlying hierarchical constraints. To bridge this gap, we present a multi-task pre-training approach for German traffic law (StVO). Our approach combines three complementary objectives: Next Sentence Prediction (NSP), Knowledge Graph (KG) Guided Clustering (CLU), and Knowledge Graph (KG) Aware Paragraph Classification (CLS). This approach explicitly encodes structured legal knowledge directly into the model weights. This encoding enables zero-shot legal reasoning at inference time and removes the need for discrete graph traversal. translated_title: 通过知识图谱引导的多任务预训练增强预训练语言模型中的法律推理能力
translated_abstract: 法律语言理解需要对半结构化的法规文件进行推理，然而标准的预训练目标并未明确针对这种结构化能力。由于当前的法律语言模型仅依赖掩码语言建模，它们将法条文本视为扁平的词元序列，而忽略了底层的层级约束。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种针对德国交通法规（StVO）的多任务预训练方法。我们的方法结合了三个互补的预训练目标：下一句预测（NSP）、知识图谱（KG）引导的聚类（CLU）以及知识图谱（KG）感知的段落分类（CLS）。该方法将结构化的法律知识显式地直接编码到模型权重中。这种编码方式使模型能够在推理时进行零样本法律推理，并且无需离散的图遍历。我们在九个基于Transformer的编码器和324个实验设置上对该方法进行了评估。
tldr: 提出了一种结合下一句预测、知识图谱引导聚类和知识图谱感知段落分类的多任务预训练方法，将结构化法律知识直接编码进模型权重，从而实现无需图遍历的零样本法律推理。
en_tdlr: Proposes a multi-task pre-training approach combining Next Sentence Prediction, Knowledge Graph-guided clustering, and KG-aware paragraph classification to explicitly encode structured legal knowledge into model weights, enabling zero-shot legal reasoning without discrete graph traversal.
